description: The bar chart illustrates the performance gain (in percentage points) of three large language models—GPT-4o, Claude-3.5-Sonnet, and Qwen2-72B-VL—under two supervision conditions: “Strong Supervision” (represented by hatched blue bars) and “Weak Supervision” (solid light blue bars), as evaluated in the context of the VisuoThink framework for enhancing multimodal reasoning via tree search. The vertical axis, labeled “Performance Gain (+%)”, ranges from 0 to 30 with major gridlines at intervals of 5. For GPT-4o, strong supervision yields a performance gain of approximately 24.5%, while weak supervision results in about 5.2%. Claude-3.5-Sonnet shows a gain of roughly 9.3% under strong supervision and 3.6% under weak supervision. Qwen2-72B-VL achieves approximately 15.1% under strong supervision and 5.3% under weak supervision. Across all models, strong supervision consistently produces significantly higher performance gains than weak supervision, with GPT-4o exhibiting the largest absolute gain under strong supervision. The bars are grouped by model along the horizontal axis, with strong supervision bars positioned to the left of their corresponding weak supervision bars within each group. No bars are sorted by value; they are ordered by model name. The legend at the top distinguishes the two supervision types by pattern and color.
